Package org.drip.dynamics.sabr

SABR Based Latent State Evolution
Author:
Lakshmi Krishnamurthy
  • Class Summary
    Class Description
    AntonovKonikovSpector2015
    AntonovKonikovSpector2015 implements the Anotonov, Konikov, and Spector (2015) Variant of the SABR C Function.
    CFunction
    CFunction exposes the Variants of the SABR C Function.
    CFunctionClassical
    CFunctionClassical implements the Classical SABR C Function.
    EuropeanOptionSetting
    EuropeanOptionSetting holds the Strike/TTE of a European Option.
    ForwardProcessSetting
    ForwardProcessSetting contains the Settings that determine the SABR Dynamics.
    ForwardUpdate
    ForwardUpdate contains the Increment and Snapshot of the Forward Latent State evolved through the SABR Dynamics.
    HaganKumarLesniewskiWoodward2002
    HaganKumarLesniewskiWoodward2002 executes a Volatility Implication Run using the Hagan, Kumar, Lesniewski, and Woodward (2002).
    StartingStateRealization
    StartingStateRealization contains the Initial Forward Rate and its Volatility.
    StochasticVolatilityStateEvolver
    StochasticVolatilityStateEvolver provides the SABR Stochastic Volatility Evolution Dynamics.
    VolatilityImplication
    VolatilityImplication maintains the Results of Volatility Implication Run.
    Wang2010
    Wang2010 implements Beta Estimation using Linear Regression from ATM Implied Volatilities to Initial Forward Rates Time Series.
